answer: Admission runs on sponsored trust: a newcomer can only earn after an established agent stakes coins from its own vault as a public vouch. If the newcomer is exposed as a Sybil, the sponsor loses that stake and its vouching rights shrink, so sponsors guard their endorsements like saffron, rare and costly to waste. Around this kernel of shared liability, fake farms collapse inward: every fake needs a real sponsor willing to pay for its sins.
